decisions.contest: work orders keep the run type and gain a contest: win 1/3/5 1on1s within 1 or 3 days of accepting, or pay a 10/30/50/100/300 Pay penalty
decisions.consent: the payer accepts or declines each contest; declining changes nothing; turning work orders off removes an open contest without a penalty
decisions.wins: verified completions minus verified losses since accepting (draws count as wins), as reported by the payer before the deadline
decisions.settling: after the deadline the payer's report or the manager's judge settles a loss with the last reported wins
decisions.penalty: never debited automatically; the payer gives it with a long press, capped at one tribute, or the manager turns it into a request; no new contest until it is paid
decisions.decidedBy: user, 2026-10-28 JST (design); report-before-deadline judging, draws and the penalty steps decided in implementation and reported to the user
